events.title: Demo Update 2026/10/21
events.summary: There have been several reports of the game crashing when starting a new run, but only if the demo had been played before the previous update.This update updates Godot from 4.6.0 to 4.6.3.It also reverts the previous change, so Vulkan is now the default renderer again.If you want to force dx12, you can add the --rendering-driver d3d12 flag to the launch options in Steam. If it still crashes after this, please post in the forum with more details!Also there were reports before of "green blobs" app

events.title: Demo Update 2026/10/19
events.summary: The default renderer on windows has been changed to DX12 instead of Vulkan. This should hopefully fix issues with green blobs.The way the game enters full screen has changed, it may fix issues that linux users have reported with this.

events.title: Demo Update 2026/10/16
events.summary: I may have gone a little overboard with the difficulty changes!This update remedies that slightly:Raised luck and the strength of luck slightlyRaised the baseline luck for the Classic deck slightlyLowered the speed at which Jimmy gets to tenpai by 1 turn

events.title: Demo Update 2026/10/14
events.summary: Almost 2000 people have played the demo so far! And many of you have given very useful feedback.Here are some updates:BalanceLuck has been nerfed - the strength of it, and also the rate at which you accumulate it. The luck you get from repeated rounds has also been halved. events.title: Demo Update 2026/09/26

events.title: The demo is out now!
events.summary: The demo is live now! It will be in the October Next Fest. Please give it a go, leave a review, and submit feedback. I want to make it as good as possible.

events.title: The playtest is over
events.summary: The playtest is now over!Once again thanks to everyone who gave it a try.The demo will arrive next week.

events.title: Hell Wait playtest is available
events.summary: The playtest for Hell Wait is available now!Currently it supports English, Japanese, and Italian. Simplified and Traditional Chinese will be coming soon. Please try to break it any way you can (except the tutorial - I know that is full of holes). Let me know what is confusing or unintuitive. You can press F2 to submit feedback in game, or you can message me on twitter or where ever you find me. Note to streamers: you can stream it, no restrictions.
